verdict.rationale: uv is itself an official first-party CLI with a documented command reference. Its documented commands cover projects (init/add/remove/lock), tools (uv tool run/uvx/install), Python versions, cache, and self update, plus shell autocompletion and a JSON output option. Community users independently praise its ergonomic CLI. missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (JSON) output across commands beyond `uv version`, and agent-specific CLI guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can create a new Python project using the `uv init` command
Run a tool in an ephemeral environment using `uvx` (an alias for `uv tool run`)
